name: Saus, Camallera i Llampaies (Spain)
description: Barry of three yellow and three red stripes, with a white semicircle at the hoist bearing the dark green palm of the arms.
history: The flag was approved on 14 February 2008 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 5079 of 27 February 2008; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, barry of six pieces, three yellow and three red, with a white circular segment at the hoist charged with the dark green palm of the arms, 11/12 of the height.
